Bill.BriefDescription: Specifying the duty of publicly owned utilities to serve within their service areas.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to duties of utilities to serve; adding a newsection to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.92RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in subsection (2) of this section,a city or town that provides water or sewer service outside thecorporate boundaries of the city or town shall not, as condition ofproviding water or sewer service, impose, demand, or negotiate anycondition requiring: (a) Lot sizes different from those required by the jurisdictionwith zoning authority over the property; or (b) Other development or design requirements not required by thelocal government with jurisdiction over the property. (2) A city or town may impose conditions not otherwise allowedunder subsection (1) of this section if the conditions are necessary to p. 1 HB 2899the proper functioning of the water or sewer service. The burden ofproof shall be on the city or town to demonstrate that the condition isnecessary to the proper functioning of the water or sewer service.
